Who we are

Engineering the 

extraordinary

# Groundbreaking healthcare technology solutions for the most complex and challenging conditions.
# Inspiring hope and new possibility in people all over the world.

[ See how ][175]

HEALTHCARE TECHNOLOGY

## Medtronic Engineering & Innovation Center (MEIC)

MEIC symbolizes Medtronic’s commitment to R&D and innovation in healthcare. It serves as a
technology hub to deliver on our mission.

[ Learn more ][176]

PUT PATIENTS FIRST

## See the signs, seize your destiny.

The #TimetoDecideDestiny campaign aims to create awareness about the importance of stroke prevention
and timely treatment by reaching the nearest stroke-ready hospital.

[ Learn more ][177]

PATIENT EQUITY

## Decode your rhythm

Learn about bradycardia and leadless pacemaker therapy. Explore causes, symptoms, and care tips.
#DecodeYourRhythm

[ Learn more ][178]

HealthCare Technology

## Medtronic Global Diabetes Capability Center

Engineering technology that simplifies diabetes care

[ Learn more ][179]

## Creating connections to optimize healthcare systems

Innovation without collaboration isn't enough. We work closely with healthcare professionals to
introduce new therapies and optimize treatments.

[ Read more ][180]

Our impact

## Impact with purpose

#### With 95,000-plus people in over 150 countries, we see extraordinary possibilities to further
#### increase our positive impact in the world. We are committed to accelerating access to
#### healthcare technology, advancing inclusion, diversity & equity, and protecting our planet.

[ Learn more ][181]

## Join the team that powers the extraordinary

Want to do work that has the potential to make the world a better place? Then join us. Speed and
decisiveness run through our DNA. Diverse perspectives inspire bold solutions to the world’s most
complex and challenging conditions. Our careers change lives.

SnoreRx gently props your jaw forward to keep your airway clear so that you can breathe peacefully
while you sleep.

[Diagram of Airway]
[Diagram of Airway]

Before SnoreRx

Snoring is the embarrassing and annoying sound that happens when air is forced past the collapsed
muscles in your throat. The muscles in this area relax when you sleep, and this can close off your
airways and make it difficult to breathe.

### Rating

my snoring. This has stopped my storing! Since I do have TMJ, I do wake up with my mouth hurting and
sometimes a headache. I've just decided to keep trying to save our sanity. I highly recommend this
product, but you will need a few nights to get used to it.

June 28, 2025

averaging in the 80s and going up into the 100s (very loud and sustained). My first night using the

recommend SnoreRx.

June 17, 2025

### John in the boonies

### Rating

4 out of 5 stars

I was prescribed a SomnoGuard mandibular advancement device (MAD) several years ago by my ENT. I
used one for about 3 years. My Medicare Advantage plan paid a good bit on this, until I changed
plans and the ENT for some reason would only sell me a noncovered device for full retail ($700+). I
looked online for an alternative. My research lead me several different devices. The SnoreRX seemed
to be the closest alternative in structure and operation to the SomnoGuard so I decided to try it.
Much less expensive, thankfully, as I am not getting any insurance coverage. The SnoreRX seems to
work pretty well. Because I already knew about MAD operation and had used the SomnoGuard, I adapted
quickly to the SnoreRX. It seems to work just about as well. I note the following differences: (1)
the tooth impressions are not as deep as the SomnoGuard, so the SnoreRX does not hold as firmly to
the teeth; (2) there is something about the hinge at the back that irritates my gum on one side, I
think the hinge has a protrusion that rubs or catches some of my gum; I do not know if I will adapt
to this; (3) the SomnoGuard allows for more lateral movement of the jaw, which the SnoreRX does not;
it helps to have a bit more lateral movement: (4) the adjustment feature is a little tricky, but not
too bad, I had to fiddle with it. But overall, I intend to keep with the SnoreRX as long as it
remains affordable … I hope they can make some minor improvements as suggested.

## Tired Of Broken Sleep, Growing Resentment, And Uncomfortable Devices?

Nearly half of adults snore at least occasionally, and that nightly noise can disrupt shared sleep,
fuel relationship stress, and leave both partners running on fumes.

#### Dry-Mouth & Dehydration

You're tired of open-mouth breathing leading to dry mouth, sore throat, and groggy mornings that
won't seem to end.

#### Sleep Separation

You're tired of repeated wake-ups leading to nudges, earplugs, or separate beds turning nights
together into nights apart.

#### Uncomfortable Devices

You’re tired of overpriced snoring gadgets that are uncomfortable, awkward, and anything but
natural.

#### Worsening Over Time

Your partner is tired of watching your occasional snoring grow louder and more frequent as airway
inflammation builds night after night.

## Snoring Is An Inside Job

### Snoring isn’t just “noise.”

Snoring isn't just your nose it's your entire airway system.

It’s a physical airway issue and most snoring starts inside the airways.

When airflow becomes restricted during sleep, tissues in the mouth and back of the throat vibrate,
creating the sound of snoring and disrupting healthy breathing.

That’s why breathing can become loud and uneven, sleep gets interrupted, and oxygen flow may be
reduced throughout the night.

SnoreStop is designed to help open blocked airways from the inside for smoother airflow, and it also
helps dry out built-up mucus in the nose that can contribute to congestion and make snoring worse.

Even if the snorer isn’t aware of it, their body is working harder to breathe, and their partner’s
sleep is affected too.

##### Schließen Sie sich über 1 Million Patienten an, die weltweit mit SomnoMed behandelt werden.

[ Erfahren Sie mehr ][52]

## [Sie leiden unter Schlafapnoe und suchen eine Alternative zur CPAP?][53]

##### Ihr CPAP-Gerät ist unbequem und Sie finden es schwierig, es jede Nacht zu nutzen?

[ Hier das komplette Video ansehen ][54]
Search Search
Ich bin Patient Ich bin Schlafmediziner Ich bin Zahnarzt
[SomnoDent Avant, Schienen-Therapiegerät zur Behandlung von Schlafapnoe]

## Therapie von obstruktiver Schlafapnoe mit Schienen von SomnoMed^{®}

Schnarchen und obstruktive Schlafapnoe (OSA) können dadurch verursacht werden, dass sich die
Atemwege im hinteren Teil Ihres Rachens während des Schlafs verengen.
Unterkieferprotrusions-Schienen, wie unsere SomnoDent Avant^{®}, bewegen Kiefer und Zunge nach
vorne, um so während des Schlafs die Atemwege offen zu halten.

[ Mehr erfahren ][55]

## Weltweit führend bei der Behandlung von OSA mit Unterkiefer-protrusionsschienen

SomnoMed ist der weltweit größte Anbieter von Schlafapnoe-Schienen und in 28 Ländern vertreten. Seit
2004 haben wir mehr als 1.000.000 Patienten zu einem komfortablen Schlaf verholfen und ihre
obstruktive Schlafapnoe (OSA) effektiv behandelt.
Wir fertigen Ihre Schlafapnoe-Schiene nach denselben Qualitätsstandards für medizinische Geräte, die
auch für Herzschrittmacher verwendet werden, und stellen sicher, dass Ihre Schiene für Ihre erste
Nacht – und jede weitere Nacht – komfortabel ist.

[ Mehr erfahren ][56]
[Frau, erwacht und entdeckt was SomnoMed ihr bieten kann.]
[ [Männlicher Patient erfreut sich einer verbesserten Lebensqualität nach einer erholsamen
Nachtruhe.] ][57]

## Unsere bisher komfortabelste Schlafapnoe-Schiene

Verglichen mit dem Tragen einer CPAP-Maske bietet eine SomnoDent Avant höchsten Komfort. Das spüren
Sie vom ersten Moment an, wenn Sie die Schiene in den Mund nehmen und diese sanft auf Ihre Zähne
gleitet. Lesen Sie, wie unsere b-flex Comfort Liner^{®} Innenschicht unvergleichlichen Komfort und
Passgenauigkeit bietet.  

[ Mehr erfahren ][58]

## Über eine Million Leben verändert

Seit 2004 hat SomnoMed über eine Million Mundvorrichtungen an Patienten in 28 Ländern geliefert –
über eine Million Menschen schlafen nun bequem und Familien genießen ruhige Nächte.

Unsere Zusammenarbeit mit Schlafmedizinern hat gezeigt, dass die Therapie mit Mundvorrichtungen eine
wirksame Alternative zur CPAP-Therapie ist. Mit einer durchschnittlichen Nutzungsdauer von** 6,9
Stunden pro Nacht¹ und einer Verbesserung der Schlafqualität bei 91 % der Patientent^{2,}** die
unsere SomnoDent Avant verwenden, könnte die Therapie mit Mundvorrichtungen die bevorzugte Wahl für
Sie sein, um sich von den Einschränkungen der CPAP-Therapie zu befreien.

**Sind Sie bereit, bessere Behandlungsmöglichkeiten für Schlafapnoe zu entdecken?**

[ Kontakt ][59]
[Youre-one-in-a-million-web-banner.jpg]

## [Was berichten SomnoMed Patienten?][60]

**Jeder Patient ist unterschiedlich und wir haben schon viele auf ihrem Weg zu einer effektiven
Behandlung begleitet.  **

Sehen Sie ihre Geschichte und wie die SomnoDent Protrusionsschiene ihnen geholfen hat.

## Patientenerfahrungen

### **Man spürt sie kaum**

Ich habe die SomnoDent-Schiene seit einem halben Jahr und muss sagen, dass es mir dank dieser
Schiene wesentlich besser geht. Es sind noch nicht alle Probleme beseitig, da sich mein Körper durch
jahrelange Erschöpfung erst so langsam erholt. Ich kann jedem diese Schiene empfehlen, der nicht mit
eine Maske leben möchte. Die Schiene ist so leicht zu tragen und man spürt sie kaum. Ich kann es
nicht anders ausdrücken, die SomnoDent-Schiene ist mein Lebensretter. Hoffe, ich kann vielen
Menschen, die an Schlafapnoe leiden, durch meine positive Erfahrung weiterhelfen.

**- Matthias**

### **Ich habe mein Leben zurück**

Ich habe mein Leben zurück, dank SomnoDent^{®}! Jetzt habe ich wieder die grenzenlose Energie, wie
ich sie als Teenager hatte, bevor ich die Schlafapnoe bekam. Ich stehe früh auf, gehe spät ins Bett,
bin mit 51 in ein Sportstudio eingetreten (ich war nie zuvor in einem Sportstudio) und fühle mich zu
100 % voller Energie!

**- Tjark**

### **Keine Druckstellen**

Der Tragekomfort der SomnoDent ist phantastisch! 100%ige Passgenauigkeit,
keine Reibungs- oder Druckpunkte an den Übergängen zum Zahnfleisch. Damit hatte ich bei anderen
Schienen immer wieder Probleme und musste diese mehrmals neu anpassen.

**- Gaby**

### **Mein Mann ist wieder fit**

Mein Mann hatte mit der SomnoDent Schiene nur noch einen AHI von 6,6/h. Mit der Schiene kommt er
super klar. Er trägt sie jede Nacht während der kompletten Schlafzeit ohne Probleme. Nach vielen
Jahren ist er dank der SomnoDent^{®}-Schiene zum ersten Mal wieder so fit und gut drauf wie vor zehn
Jahren, als ich ihn kennengelernt hatte.

**- Mirja**

### **Wie ein neuer Mensch**

Seit ich sie benutze fühle ich mich wieder wie ein vollständiger Mensch. Ich würde sie jedem
empfehlen, der an Schlafapnoe leidet. Sie ist einfach klasse.

**- Volker**

## Snoring Health Risks

Whether your snoring is attributed to sleep apnea or not, you should familiarize yourself with the
following potential side effects:

Snoring Health Risks

─────────────────────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────────
· choking, gasping, interrupted breathing│· mental health issues          
─────────────────────────────────────────┼────────────────────────────────

─────────────────────────────────────────┼────────────────────────────────

─────────────────────────────────────────┼────────────────────────────────

─────────────────────────────────────────┼────────────────────────────────
· gastro esophageal reflux disease (GERD)│· risk of stroke                
─────────────────────────────────────────┴────────────────────────────────

Although chronic, loud snoring is a symptom of sleep apnea, individuals who snore on a frequent or
regular basis are not always diagnosed with the disorder. Regardless, you should see a doctor to
determine if you have some sort of sleeping disorder.

## What Non-surgical Treatments are recommended for Snoring?

While you might feel that snoring can be an occasional annoyance or embarrassment, in some cases,
it’s not a normal occurrence. However, there are certain health risks that are associated with
snoring and the ill effects often go beyond an annoyed spouse elbowing or kicking you to get you to
stop. There are certain non-surgical treatments for snoring that should be tried first before
considering a surgical procedure. Some remedies you can try at home include:
* avoiding alcohol in the evening
* changing your sleeping position
* losing weight
* taking OTC allergy or cold medications
* wearing oral appliances

It is always advisable to get evaluated by a doctor or healthcare provider if your snoring has any
negative consequences.

## What causes You to Snore?

Snoring occurs when the airflow through your mouth or nose gets blocked. Some of the more common
causes for blockages that interfere with that airflow include:

What Causes You to Snore?

───────────────────────────────────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────────────────────
· Blocked nasal airways caused by allergies, colds, a  │· Relaxed throat and tongue muscles (causes 
deviated septum, nasal polyps, or a sinus infection    │them to collapse back into your airway)     
───────────────────────────────────────────────────────┼────────────────────────────────────────────
· Bulky throat tissue in overweight individuals        │· Sleep deprivation                         
───────────────────────────────────────────────────────┼────────────────────────────────────────────

───────────────────────────────────────────────────────┼────────────────────────────────────────────

Although chronic, loud snoring is a symptom of sleep apnea, individuals who snore on a frequent or
regular basis are not always diagnosed with the disorder. Regardless, you should see a doctor to
determine if you have some sort of sleeping disorder.

## What Non-surgical Treatments are recommended for Snoring?

While you might feel that snoring can be an occasional annoyance or embarrassment, in some cases,
it’s not a normal occurrence. However, there are certain health risks that are associated with
snoring and the ill effects often go beyond an annoyed spouse elbowing or kicking you to get you to
stop. There are certain non-surgical treatments for snoring that should be tried first before
considering a surgical procedure. Some remedies you can try at home include:
* avoiding alcohol in the evening
* changing your sleeping position
* losing weight
* taking OTC allergy or cold medications
* wearing oral appliances

It is always advisable to get evaluated by a doctor or healthcare provider if your snoring has any
negative consequences.

# New Name, Same Care.

### AvantSleep is now Avant Respiratory

We’re excited to announce that AvantSleep is now Avant Respiratory. This evolution reflects our
expanded services beyond CPAP therapy to include oxygen therapy and respiratory care solutions
across Canada. While our name is changing, our commitment to exceptional care remains unwavering.
We’ve listened to your needs and responded by creating an integrated approach to respiratory
wellness.

[ Schedule Your Consultation Now ][27]

every detail of my sleep experience is of paramount importance. The personal attention to find the
perfect fitted mask was extremely impressive and the follow-up service has made it all worthwhile.
Thanks to Marlee and the rest of the staff, they are highly recommended!!!”

Ken G

#### Patsy O

“I have been a patient for 6 years now and am very grateful for the excellent service I have
received. When I speak to my friends who are going to other clinics, there is no comparison. The
staff is very friendly and everyone is very accommodating to my needs. I had an opportunity lately
to refer an acquaintance to your facility. I would highly recommend to anyone. Nothing but good
praises from me. Appreciate all the care that I have received and look forward to my annual visits.”

Patsy O

Our 3 step CPAP process on getting you treated is easy. Our sleep therapists and CPAP success

We know that each patient is an individual, and different people have different values and dynamics.

been proven to work. 

Our therapists have helped over 3000 CPAP compliant patients get restful sleep for over 6 hrs a

## Treatment Basics

Breathe Medical has been widely recognized within the medical community as the gold standard for
training and support of patients with obstructive sleep apnea.

CPAP therapy helps eliminate breathing difficulties during sleep, including snoring and closure of
airway.

## Treatment Quality Matters

At Breathe Medical, we understand the quality of our treatment protocol has a direct impact on
driver compliance.

### Acerca de **ENIQ**

"Nuestro propósito es cuidar tu salud y estética dental mientras liberamos tu vida del dolor crónico
de cabeza y cuello. Especialistas en bruxismo y trastornos del sueño, devolvemos a nuestros
pacientes la calidad de vida que merecen mediante un enfoque integral y humano."

En ENIQ, hemos evolucionado el concepto de clínica dental integral en Madrid para ofrecerte una
solución definitiva a tu bienestar. No solo nos especializamos en los principales tratamientos
odontológicos de vanguardia, sino que integramos una unidad avanzada dedicada al dolor facial y
cervical. Mediante el uso de la última tecnología y técnicas como la neuromodulación no invasiva
(NESA) y la punción seca, buscamos el origen real de tus síntomas —desde el bruxismo hasta las
migrañas— para tratarlos de forma eficaz y duradera. Nuestra filosofía se basa en un trato
profesional y cercano, donde cada paciente es evaluado y tratado de forma individual, acompañándote
en cada paso para devolverte la calidad de vida que mereces.

## ¿Quiénes somos?

### Acerca de **ENIQ**

"Nuestro propósito es cuidar tu salud y estética dental mientras liberamos tu vida del dolor crónico
de cabeza y cuello. Especialistas en bruxismo y trastornos del sueño, devolvemos a nuestros
pacientes la calidad de vida que merecen mediante un enfoque integral y humano."

En ENIQ, hemos evolucionado el concepto de clínica dental integral en Madrid para ofrecerte una
solución definitiva a tu bienestar. No solo nos especializamos en los principales tratamientos
odontológicos de vanguardia, sino que integramos una unidad avanzada dedicada al dolor facial y
cervical. Mediante el uso de la última tecnología y técnicas como la neuromodulación no invasiva
(NESA) y la punción seca, buscamos el origen real de tus síntomas —desde el bruxismo hasta las
migrañas— para tratarlos de forma eficaz y duradera. Nuestra filosofía se basa en un trato
profesional y cercano, donde cada paciente es evaluado y tratado de forma individual, acompañándote
en cada paso para devolverte la calidad de vida que mereces.

Data Insights Market is one of the leading providers of syndicated and customized research reports,
consulting services, and analytical information on markets and companies across the world. Data

specific needs of each client to produce relevant insights that most suit his individual needs.
Since its inception, Data Insights Market has continued to innovate, increased its product and
service portfolio, and remained focused on the needs of its clients to root out poor-quality data
and establish itself as a winning partner for businesses. DIM has a legacy of serving and
facilitating clients from all over the world and played a vital role in their success story. Our
clients include many types of organizations, the majority of which are Fortune 500 companies.

The 360-degree research methodology requires us to only dispense facilities based on our unique data
model so that the authenticity and integrity of the services are maintained. This methodology makes

## 🎥 Uzm. Dt. Merve Özkan Akagündüz *Anlatıyor*

Her ortodontik vaka farklı bir planlama ve yaklaşım gerektirir. Uzm. Dt. Merve Özkan Akagündüz,
gerçek vakalar üzerinden tedavi sürecini, kullanılan yöntemleri ve elde edilen sonuçları adım adım
anlatıyor.
1. 1
   
   ### Vakanın Başlangıcı
   
   Hastanın dişlerinin başlangıç yapısı, kapanış ilişkisi ve tedavi ihtiyacı detaylı şekilde
   değerlendirilir.
2. 2
   
   ### Tedavi Planı
   
   Vakanın ihtiyacına göre uygulanacak ortodontik yaklaşım belirlenir ve süreç kişiye özel olarak
   planlanır.
3. 3
   
   ### Tedavi Sonucu
   
   Tedavi sonunda elde edilen değişim; estetik, fonksiyon ve kapanış açısından birlikte
   değerlendirilir.

[ [Vaka Anlatımı — Uzm. Dt. Merve Özkan Akagündüz] ][69]
Nasıl Çalışıyoruz

## Plan netleşmeden *tedavi başlamıyor.*

Her tedavi muayene ile başlıyor; dört aşamalı şeffaf süreçte sürpriz yok, sadece sizin için
tasarlanmış bir yol haritası.

01

### iTero Dijital Tarama

Klasik macunlu ölçü yok; 3D dijital tarama ile dakikalar içinde dijital ağız modeliniz hazırlanır.

02

### ClinCheck 3D Simülasyon

Tedavi başlamadan önce nihai sonucu birlikte inceleriz; gülüşünüzün dönüşümünü siz de görürsünüz.

03

### Şeffaf Takip Sistemi

Her aşamayı sizinle paylaşıyoruz; ilerlemeniz, randevularınız ve değişimler her zaman görünür.

04

### Tedavi Sonrası Destek

Vivera retainer ve düzenli kontrollerle sonucu koruruz. Süreç bitse de yanınızda olmaya devam
ederiz.

## 🎥 Uzm. Dt. Merve Özkan Akagündüz *Anlatıyor*

Her ortodontik vaka farklı bir planlama ve yaklaşım gerektirir. Uzm. Dt. Merve Özkan Akagündüz,
gerçek vakalar üzerinden tedavi sürecini, kullanılan yöntemleri ve elde edilen sonuçları adım adım
anlatıyor.
1. 1
   
   ### Vakanın Başlangıcı
   
   Hastanın dişlerinin başlangıç yapısı, kapanış ilişkisi ve tedavi ihtiyacı detaylı şekilde
   değerlendirilir.
2. 2
   
   ### Tedavi Planı
   
   Vakanın ihtiyacına göre uygulanacak ortodontik yaklaşım belirlenir ve süreç kişiye özel olarak
   planlanır.
3. 3
   
   ### Tedavi Sonucu
   
   Tedavi sonunda elde edilen değişim; estetik, fonksiyon ve kapanış açısından birlikte
   değerlendirilir.

## Plan netleşmeden *tedavi başlamıyor.*

Her tedavi muayene ile başlıyor; dört aşamalı şeffaf süreçte sürpriz yok, sadece sizin için
tasarlanmış bir yol haritası.

01

### iTero Dijital Tarama

Klasik macunlu ölçü yok; 3D dijital tarama ile dakikalar içinde dijital ağız modeliniz hazırlanır.

02

### ClinCheck 3D Simülasyon

Tedavi başlamadan önce nihai sonucu birlikte inceleriz; gülüşünüzün dönüşümünü siz de görürsünüz.

03

### Şeffaf Takip Sistemi

Her aşamayı sizinle paylaşıyoruz; ilerlemeniz, randevularınız ve değişimler her zaman görünür.

04

### Tedavi Sonrası Destek

Vivera retainer ve düzenli kontrollerle sonucu koruruz. Süreç bitse de yanınızda olmaya devam
ederiz.

What steps does an ENT doctor take to diagnose ear, nose, or throat problems?

Diagnosing ENT issues starts with understanding your symptoms and medical history. The ENT doctor
examines your ears, nose, throat, and nearby structures, often using specialized instruments like
microscopes or endoscopes to see details that are not visible to the naked eye.

Depending on the findings, additional tests may be recommended, such as:
* **Hearing evaluations (audiometry)** to check for hearing loss or auditory issues
* **Allergy testing** to pinpoint triggers for nasal or sinus problems
* **Imaging scans (CT, MRI, X-ray)** to detect structural issues or tumors in the head and neck
* **Endoscopy** to closely inspect your nasal passages, throat, or airways
* **Biopsy** to examine tissue for abnormalities or cancer

After completing the diagnostic process, the ENT doctor develops a tailored treatment plan to
address your condition effectively, combining medical and surgical options as needed.

 

When should I consult a Head and Neck ENT surgeon?

You should see a Head and Neck ENT surgeon if you notice persistent or unusual lumps in the neck,
jaw, or throat; chronic ear problems such as recurring infections or hearing loss; severe or
recurring sinus infections or nasal blockages (including nasal polyps); unexplained growths, tumors,
or changes in the throat or voice; or sudden swelling, difficulty swallowing, or breathing issues.
Early evaluation ensures timely diagnosis and better outcomes. Dr. Muhammad Jabbr provides expert
Head and Neck Surgery, offering advanced surgical care and personalized management for all
ENT-related conditions.

* **Endoscopic sinus surgery (FESS)** – A minimally invasive procedure to restore sinus drainage.
* **Balloon sinuplasty** – A gentle technique to open blocked sinuses using a small balloon.
* **Steroid-eluting sinus stents** – Reduce inflammation and promote healing after surgery.
* **Image-guided sinus surgery** – High-precision surgery for complex or hard-to-reach sinuses.

These modern treatments provide long-term relief from sinus blockage, facial pain, pressure, and
post-nasal drip, helping patients breathe easier and improve their quality of life.

What steps does an ENT doctor take to diagnose ear, nose, or throat problems?

Diagnosing ENT issues starts with understanding your symptoms and medical history. The ENT doctor
examines your ears, nose, throat, and nearby structures, often using specialized instruments like
microscopes or endoscopes to see details that are not visible to the naked eye.

Depending on the findings, additional tests may be recommended, such as:
* **Hearing evaluations (audiometry)** to check for hearing loss or auditory issues
* **Allergy testing** to pinpoint triggers for nasal or sinus problems
* **Imaging scans (CT, MRI, X-ray)** to detect structural issues or tumors in the head and neck
* **Endoscopy** to closely inspect your nasal passages, throat, or airways
* **Biopsy** to examine tissue for abnormalities or cancer

After completing the diagnostic process, the ENT doctor develops a tailored treatment plan to
address your condition effectively, combining medical and surgical options as needed.

 

When should I consult a Head and Neck ENT surgeon?

You should see a Head and Neck ENT surgeon if you notice persistent or unusual lumps in the neck,
jaw, or throat; chronic ear problems such as recurring infections or hearing loss; severe or
recurring sinus infections or nasal blockages (including nasal polyps); unexplained growths, tumors,
or changes in the throat or voice; or sudden swelling, difficulty swallowing, or breathing issues.
Early evaluation ensures timely diagnosis and better outcomes. Dr. Muhammad Jabbr provides expert

* **Balloon sinuplasty** – A gentle technique to open blocked sinuses using a small balloon.
* **Steroid-eluting sinus stents** – Reduce inflammation and promote healing after surgery.
* **Image-guided sinus surgery** – High-precision surgery for complex or hard-to-reach sinuses.

These modern treatments provide long-term relief from sinus blockage, facial pain, pressure, and

featured products, and trending products from the U.S., UK, Japan, Korea, and beyond; all in one

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Do I need a prescription or referral before trying CPAP?

Yes, a prescription is required for the purchase of a PAP device and some supplies. Prescriptions
may be uploaded or faxed to Resmed Shop. If you need assistance obtaining a copy of your
prescription, Resmed Shop customer support, with your permission, can work with your health care
provider or current supplier to obtain it. If we are unable to collect a valid prescription from you
or on your behalf, we will be unable to process your order, and it may be subject to cancellation.

## Can I use insurance?

While many private insurance providers may reimburse the out-of-pocket costs for PAP equipment, it’s
important to note products sold through Resmed Shop are not eligible for reimbursement.

## Do you accept returns?

Please see our [Return Policy][142].

All products are sold through Expedite LLC, a Resmed company. 

Expedite does not accept any insurance. Expedite only ships to states where it is licensed to sell
Durable or Home Medical Equipment. A list of states where Expedite is currently licensed is
available in our Terms of Use. 

Notice to Medicare and Medicaid Beneficiaries: Medicare and Medicaid will pay for durable medical
equipment and supplies only if a supplier has a valid Medicare or Medicaid supplier number and meets
all other Medicare and Medicaid enrollment and product coverage requirements. Expedite does not have
a Medicare or Medicaid supplier number. Medicare or Medicaid will not pay for any medical equipment
and supplies we sell.  You will be personally and fully responsible for payment and agree not to
appeal if Medicare is not billed. 

Expedite is not providing medical advice and does not discuss or advise on any issues relating to
medical treatment or diagnosis.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Do I need a prescription or referral before trying CPAP?

Yes, a prescription is required for the purchase of a PAP device and some supplies. Prescriptions
may be uploaded or faxed to Resmed Shop. If you need assistance obtaining a copy of your
prescription, Resmed Shop customer support, with your permission, can work with your health care
provider or current supplier to obtain it. If we are unable to collect a valid prescription from you
or on your behalf, we will be unable to process your order, and it may be subject to cancellation.

## Can I use insurance?

While many private insurance providers may reimburse the out-of-pocket costs for PAP equipment, it’s
important to note products sold through Resmed Shop are not eligible for reimbursement.

## Do you accept returns?

Please see our [Return Policy][142].

All products are sold through Expedite LLC, a Resmed company. 

Expedite does not accept any insurance. Expedite only ships to states where it is licensed to sell
Durable or Home Medical Equipment. A list of states where Expedite is currently licensed is
available in our Terms of Use. 

Notice to Medicare and Medicaid Beneficiaries: Medicare and Medicaid will pay for durable medical
equipment and supplies only if a supplier has a valid Medicare or Medicaid supplier number and meets
all other Medicare and Medicaid enrollment and product coverage requirements. Expedite does not have
a Medicare or Medicaid supplier number. Medicare or Medicaid will not pay for any medical equipment
and supplies we sell.  You will be personally and fully responsible for payment and agree not to
appeal if Medicare is not billed. 

Expedite is not providing medical advice and does not discuss or advise on any issues relating to
medical treatment or diagnosis.

# Medical Spa & Advanced Skin Treatments in London, Ontario

# 

Specializing in laser treatments including hair removal, microneedling, PRF, and Botox for natural,
long-lasting skin rejuvenation.

﻿


[ BOOK AN APPOINTMENT ][24]

We offer personalized aesthetic treatments in London, Ontario, focused on improving skin health,
texture, and overall appearance. Our approach combines advanced technology with regenerative
treatments to deliver natural, long-lasting results.

## Discover Moser MediSpa & Rejuvenation — Cosmetic Treatments In Your Own Backyard



I truly believe that cosmetic treatments are about so much more than appearance—they’re about
feeling comfortable, confident, and at home in your own skin. For many of my clients, it’s the first
time they’ve looked in the mirror and really felt beautiful. That kind of shift isn’t vanity—it’s
healing. And it’s why I focus so much on regenerative treatments that support the skin’s health from
the inside out.



But let’s be real: similar to not getting fit after one workout, you won’t get glowing, rejuvenated
skin after a single session. Lasting change takes time, consistency, and commitment. Regenerative
results come from building a foundation, especially if your skin’s been through a lot over the
years. If you were a sun lover who skipped the SPF, it’s going to take more than one visit to
reverse the damage. I’m good at what I do—but I’m not a magical wizard. What I am is
results-obsessed, and I pride myself on my honesty.

If there’s nothing to treat, I’ll tell you. If your results aren’t where I want them to be, I won’t
keep going just for the sake of it. And if something’s going to sting a little, I’ll make sure
you’re prepared—and yes, I’ll hold your hand through it. I’m a nurse first and a business owner
second. Your safety, comfort, and regenerative outcomes always come first.



Whether we’re working on fine lines, acne scars, sun damage, or overall skin texture, my approach is
rooted in [regenerative therapies][25] that activate the body’s own healing abilities. These
treatments don’t just mask issues—they work with your body to rebuild healthier, stronger skin over
time. And no matter where you’re starting, you’ll always be treated with honesty and compassion.

### Serving clients in London, Ontario and surrounding areas.

## Fotona4D® Give Your Face a More Youthful Look Without Surgery

One of my most popular treatments, this [regenerative, non-surgical laser procedure][26] lifts,
tightens, and rejuvenates the face, offering natural-looking results without the need for
injectables or fillers. If you're looking for a safer, more holistic alternative to traditional
anti-aging options, this treatment is a client favourite for good reason.



**Fotona4D®** stimulates collagen production, firms the skin, improves tone and texture, and
restores lost volume while encouraging your body’s own regenerative processes. The result is a
full-face lift effect, improved complexion, and a fresh, healthy glow with minimal to no downtime.



**Fotona4D®** is ideal for treating fine lines, wrinkles, sagging skin, and that overall tired look
we all want to shake. This is a true regenerative treatment—no shortcuts, no masking—just real skin
health, renewed from within.

Oral Appliances

 Welcome to OralAppliances.com, your online resource center for Oral Appliance Therapy, and
appliances used in the treatment snoring and sleep apnea.

According to the American Academy of Dental Sleep Medicine, oral appliances are a front-line
treatment for snoring and mild to moderate obstructive sleep apnea. These small plastic devices fit
in the mouth during sleep like a sports mouth guard or orthodontic retainer.

Oral appliances help prevent the collapse of the tongue and soft tissues in the back of the throat,
keeping the airway open during sleep and promoting adequate air intake. Oral appliances may be used
alone or in combination with other treatments for sleep-related breathing disorders, such as weight
management, surgery or CPAP.

[BreathAgain-rdx]

What is Oral Appliance Therapy?

**Oral appliance therapy involves the selection, fitting and use of a specially designed oral
appliance that maintains an open, unobstructed airway in the throat when worn during sleep. 
Dentists are among the first line of defense in treating patients who suffer with snoring or sleep
apnea.  After extensive [dental continuing education][13], Dentists are trained with the complete
sleep protocol and are familiar with the various designs of appliances.**

**Custom-made oral appliances are proven to be effective, and provide a higher rate of patient
compliance than the CPAP.  When fitting your patients for an oral appliance, remember:  Its not the
appliance you choose, but more importantly the position in which the mandible is placed.**

**Ongoing care, including short- and long-term follow-up is an essential step in the treatment of
snoring and Obstructive Sleep Apnea with Oral Appliance Therapy.**

apnea.  After extensive [dental continuing education][13], Dentists are trained with the complete
sleep protocol and are familiar with the various designs of appliances.**

**Custom-made oral appliances are proven to be effective, and provide a higher rate of patient
compliance than the CPAP.  When fitting your patients for an oral appliance, remember:  Its not the
appliance you choose, but more importantly the position in which the mandible is placed.**

**Ongoing care, including short- and long-term follow-up is an essential step in the treatment of
snoring and Obstructive Sleep Apnea with Oral Appliance Therapy.**
